messages:
Lucy (PM): Quick sync — we need an "evidence pack" for Console Observability launch criteria by EOD Friday. Customer A wants: per-route cost breakdown, trace hooks tied to generation spans, and error analytic slices by model-version. Can we outline what 'done' looks like?
Aj (Eng): Sounds good. Proposed acceptance: 1) Dashboard with per-route unblended token cost + 7d trend, 2) Tracing hook that maps request->model invocation->kv-cache hits, 3) Error table keyed by model version and prompt family, with sample ratio.
Kevin (SRE): For the trace hooks: we can emit span attributes: `model.version`, `route.id`, `batch.size`, `kv_cache_hit=true/false`. Need to confirm sampling policy — full traces will blow ingest costs. Suggest 1% by default + 100% for canary accounts.
Sophie (Design): For the dashboard UX — minimal: a single pane with top 5 cost contributors, a drilldown that shows token breakdown (prompt vs completion) and a histogram of latency. Wireframes ready, attaching proto link in thread. UX should surface anomalies and recommend quantization/config suggestions.
Nikhil (Data): Error analytics needs labeling of prompt families. We can run an offline join between eval buckets and telemetry to create a `prompt_family` dimension. Will take ~2 days to stabilise. Also want to pin the cardinality limits (no more than 50 families initially).
Lucy (PM): Good notes — can we also call out launch gating thresholds? e.g. dashboard is enabled when cost accuracy within 5% vs billing, trace hook retention 7d, error table sample rate >= 0.5% for active routes.
Aj (Eng): Implementation notes: batching + prefix caching affects token attribution. We'll add attribution tag on tokens emitted by runtime so cost calc can attribute to `route.id` and `model.variant`. Pseudocode we will add to runtime:```json
{"token": "...", "route":"r-123", "model":"gptx-1.2", "attribution":"completion"}
```This will let data pipeline compute token-cost per route.
Kevin (SRE): Ops concerns: storing traces + waveform of kv-cache hits doubles ingest. We should gate extra attributes behind a feature flag per customer tier. Also need a migration plan for customers on Dedicated.
Sophie (Design): Small UX ask — add a compact 'why is cost high' card that links to common culprits: long context, unpinned model rollout, high sample rate. One-liner recommendations only.
Lucy (PM): Risks & mitigations: 1) Cost overrun on telemetry -> cap events by sampling; 2) Wrong attribution -> reconciliation test with billing; 3) Customer confusion -> include an FAQ + signal examples. I'll draft the FAQ.
Aj (Eng): Dependencies: data pipeline schema change (Nikhil), runtime tag emission (Eng-runtime), console widget (Sophie), rollout gating (Kevin). ETA: staggered sprints — runtime + schema week 1, pipeline + dashboard week 2, soft-launch week 3.
Nikhil (Data): For reconciliation, we'll surface a nightly job `cost_recon` that compares token-derived cost to billing. We'll add a `recon_confidence` score to the dashboard.
ops-bot: deploy-bot deployed canary observability-hooks to staging at 2309876555 :rocket:
Kevin (SRE): Can we add launch criteria checklist? I'll start a short checklist in the repo: `data_recon_ok`, `trace_sample_configured`, `dashboard_visuals_signed_off`, `sla_latency_ok`. When all true -> enable rollout.
Lucy (PM): Perfect. Action items: Aj -> runtime tag PR by tomorrow, Nikhil -> schema + recon job draft, Sophie -> updated mock + copy for FAQ, Kevin -> gating flags + checklist. I'll collate into the evidence pack doc and attach to the customer readout. Any blockers?
Aj (Eng): One blocker: quantization affects token count sometimes (post-tokenization differences). Need to add a note that tokenization parity check must pass before we mark `cost_accuracy` as met.
Lucy (PM): Noted. Thanks everyone. Final ask: keep comments inline in the evidence pack doc — I will review on Thursday morning. :white_check_mark:
